comm_center.name: Comm Center
comm_center.desc: Global technologies — researched once, applied across all planets

spacebase.name: Space Base
spacebase.desc: Launch pad for drones and colony ships

defense.name: Defense
defense.desc: Planetary shields, weapons platforms and early-warning systems

hightech.name: High-Tech
hightech.desc: Advanced material refinement and planet-exclusive processing

dock.name: Dock
dock.desc: Ship management, missions and fleet operations

terrestrial.name: Terrestrial
terrestrial.desc: Balanced planet. All standard buildings available, no special bonuses.

volcanic.name: Volcanic
volcanic.desc: Rich in metal. Special mining & energy buildings, limited agriculture.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.desc: Crystal-rich permafrost. Special excavators and cryo research.

ocean.name: Ocean
ocean.desc: Farming paradise. Enormous population potential, weak mining.

uninhabitable.name: Uninhabitable
uninhabitable.desc: Hostile or barren — colonization not possible.

command_center.name: Command Center
command_center.desc: The heart of your colony. Must be built before anything else.
command_center.lv2: Unlocks the Tech Center tile · +5 pop · uses 2 energy · 2 workers

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.desc: Powers the colony. Build and upgrade to support more buildings.

metal_mine.name: Metal Mine
metal_mine.desc: Extracts metal ore from the surface.

alloy_forge.name: Alloy Forge
alloy_forge.desc: Smelts metal into refined alloy. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

biomass_collector.name: Biomass Collector
biomass_collector.desc: Harvests organic biomass from ocean floors. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

obsidian_quarry.name: Obsidian Quarry
obsidian_quarry.desc: Excavates volcanic obsidian from lava fields. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

cryo_extractor.name: Cryo Extractor
cryo_extractor.desc: Harvests cryonite from frozen veins. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

solar_array.name: Solar Array
solar_array.desc: Harvests solar energy. No energy drain.

cryo_reactor.name: Cryo Reactor
cryo_reactor.desc: Harnesses extreme cold for high-yield energy. Frozen planets only.

alloy_fusion_reactor.name: Alloy Fusion Reactor
alloy_fusion_reactor.desc: Fuses refined alloy for high-yield energy. Terrestrial planets only.

obsidian_plasma_core.name: Obsidian Plasma Core
obsidian_plasma_core.desc: Superheats obsidian into plasma for massive energy output. Volcanic planets only.

biomass_reactor.name: Biomass Reactor
biomass_reactor.desc: Converts biomass into clean sustained energy. Ocean planets only.

recon_drone.name: Recon Drone
recon_drone.desc: Short-range drone that reveals planet details in the home system.
recon_drone.lv1: Scout 1 planet at a time · standard speed · uses 5 energy · 2 workers
recon_drone.lv2: Scout 2 planets simultaneously · 2× speed · uses 8 energy · 3 workers
recon_drone.lv3: Scout 3 planets simultaneously · 3× speed · uses 14 energy · 5 workers

star_map.name: Star Map
star_map.desc: Charts the known galaxy. Required for interplanetary navigation.
star_map.lv1: Unlocks Solar System view · uses 3 energy · 2 workers
star_map.lv2: Unlocks Galaxy view · nearby systems visible · uses 5 energy · 3 workers
star_map.lv3: Full galaxy scan — all systems visible · uses 9 energy · 5 workers

interstellar_comm.name: Interstellar Communication
interstellar_comm.desc: Scan distant star systems and contact their inhabitants. Researched once, applied galaxy-wide.
interstellar_comm.lv1: Unlock system scanning + predefined messages · uses 4 energy · 2 workers
interstellar_comm.lv2: Halve signal travel time · uses 7 energy · 3 workers

space_building.name: Space Technology
space_building.desc: Advances propulsion and navigation science. Unlocks the Space Base tile.
space_building.lv1: Unlocks Space Base tile · uses 6 energy · 3 workers
space_building.lv2: Unlocks Warship Bay · uses 10 energy · 5 workers

laboratory.name: Laboratory
laboratory.desc: Drives scientific progress. High energy consumer.
laboratory.lv1: Unlocks High-Tech tile · uses 5 energy · 3 workers
laboratory.lv2: Unlocks Alloy Forge · +50% research speed · uses 8 energy · 5 workers

weapons_building.name: Weapon Technology
weapons_building.desc: Military science division. Unlocks the planetary Defense tile.
weapons_building.lv1: Unlocks Defense tile · basic weapon blueprints · uses 5 energy · 3 workers

colony_ship.name: Colony Ship
colony_ship.desc: Transports colonists to unoccupied planets in the solar system.
colony_ship.lv1: Colonize 1 uncolonized planet in home system · uses 8 energy · 4 workers
colony_ship.lv2: Colonize planets in adjacent star systems · uses 14 energy · 7 workers
colony_ship.lv3: Mass colonization fleet · reach distant systems · uses 24 energy · 12 workers

geothermal_tap.name: Geothermal Tap
geothermal_tap.desc: Harnesses volcanic heat for cheap, reliable energy output.

tidal_generator.name: Tidal Generator
tidal_generator.desc: Harvests kinetic energy from ocean tides. Cheap and reliable.

alloy_refinery.name: Alloy Refinery
alloy_refinery.desc: Fuses metal and alloy into Super Alloy. Terrestrial planets only.
alloy_refinery.lv1: Unlocks Super Alloy production · uses 6 energy · 3 workers

obsidian_foundry.name: Obsidian Foundry
obsidian_foundry.desc: Superheats obsidian and crystal into Quantum Shards. Volcanic planets only.
obsidian_foundry.lv1: Unlocks Quantum Shard production · uses 6 energy · 3 workers

cryo_refinery.name: Cryo Refinery
cryo_refinery.desc: Purifies crystal using cryonite into Pure Crystal. Frozen planets only.
cryo_refinery.lv1: Unlocks Pure Crystal production · uses 6 energy · 3 workers

bio_lab.name: Bio Lab
bio_lab.desc: Synthesizes biomass and metal into Nano Alloy. Ocean planets only.
bio_lab.lv1: Unlocks Nano Alloy production · uses 6 energy · 3 workers

power_cell_lab.name: Power Cell Lab
power_cell_lab.desc: Manufactures universal power cells for starships.
power_cell_lab.lv1: Produce Power Cells · uses 5 energy · 3 workers

shield_generator.name: Shield Generator
shield_generator.desc: Projects an energy barrier around the planet.
shield_generator.lv1: Basic shield — absorbs 20% incoming damage · uses 8 energy · 3 workers
shield_generator.lv2: Enhanced shield — absorbs 40% incoming damage · uses 15 energy · 5 workers
shield_generator.lv3: Fortress shield — absorbs 60% incoming damage · uses 25 energy · 8 workers
